generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the broadleaf base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the broadleaf program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 231 Oleaceae: trees, shrubs or climbers; leaves opposite, very rarely alternate, simple or pinnate; stipules absent; flowers regular; calyx lobed, rarely absent; petals often 4, free or joined, or absent (as in many ashes); stamens usually 2; ovary superior, 2-celled.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Oleaceae: how long the leaves last (character 37), coded usually evergreen, often deciduous. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 21 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
